name: Poland
gaps: Many regional Towarzystwo Ornitologiczne branches exist but lack individual websites; referencing main OTOP portal instead. Extensive OTOP local group network of 18+ groups verified through official directory but individual pages scattered across OTOP.org.pl, Facebook, and emails.

groups.name: OTOP (Polish Society for the Protection of Birds)
groups.blurb: The national bird protection society and BirdLife partner, with 18 local groups running walks, surveys and conservation work across Poland.

groups.name: Ornitho.pl
groups.blurb: Poland's bird observation platform for recording and viewing distribution maps of bird sightings and species occurrences.

groups.name: Monitoring Ptaków Polski (MBP)
groups.blurb: The national bird monitoring scheme with 25 programmes covering 190 bird species and over 800 amateur and professional observers.

groups.name: Warszawska Grupa OTOP
groups.blurb: Warsaw OTOP local group conducting field walks, lectures and bird protection activities in the capital region.

groups.name: Białołęcka Grupa OTOP
groups.blurb: Warsaw district local group promoting bird observation and protection in Białołęka.

groups.name: Mazowiecko-Świętokrzyskie Towarzystwo Ornitologiczne
groups.blurb: Regional ornithological society protecting fauna and flora in Masovian and Holy Cross regions since 2006.

groups.name: Poznańska Grupa OTOP
groups.blurb: Poznań OTOP local group organizing bird walks, trips and citizen science activities across the region.

groups.name: Trójmiejska Grupa OTOP
groups.blurb: Tricity OTOP group (Gdańsk, Gdynia, Sopot) running ornithological excursions and conservation projects.

groups.name: Stacja Ornitologiczna MiIZ PAN (Polish Ringing Centre)
groups.blurb: Ornithological research station in Gdańsk coordinating bird ringing, research and population monitoring since 1931.

groups.name: Małopolskie Towarzystwo Ornitologiczne
groups.blurb: Regional ornithological society researching and protecting birds across Kraków and Lesser Poland since 1982.

groups.name: Lubelskie Towarzystwo Ornitologiczne
groups.blurb: Lublin region ornithological society conducting bird research, protection and education in eastern Poland.

groups.name: Czech Society for Ornithology (CSO / Česká společnost ornitologická)
groups.blurb: The national ornithological society and BirdLife partner with 7,800 members and nine regional branches across the country.

groups.name: Severočeská pobočka ČSO
groups.blurb: North Bohemian branch of CSO running ornithological excursions and community activities.

groups.name: Západočeská pobočka ČSO
groups.blurb: West Bohemian branch of CSO conducting bird research and protection in the region.

groups.name: Pobočka Střední Čechy a Praha
groups.blurb: Central Bohemia and Prague branch serving the capital region and surrounding areas.

groups.name: Jihočeský ornitologický klub
groups.blurb: South Bohemian ornithological club organizing bird studies and protection activities.

groups.name: Východočeská pobočka ČSO
groups.blurb: East Bohemian branch with nearly 200 members running walks and surveys in Hradec Králové and Pardubice regions.

groups.name: Jihomoravská pobočka ČSO
groups.blurb: South Moravian branch of CSO based in Brno coordinating ornithological activities and research.

groups.name: Moravský ornitologický spolek
groups.blurb: Central Moravian ornithological society working on bird research and conservation.

name: Slovakia
gaps: SOS/BirdLife Slovakia maintains regional branches across all regions but individual branch websites and contact information not publicly listed online. Main organization portal and Facebook are primary findable resources.

groups.name: SOS/BirdLife Slovakia (Slovak Ornithological Society)
groups.blurb: The national bird conservation organization and BirdLife partner with over 1,000 members and regional branches in all regions of Slovakia.

name: Hungary
gaps: MME operates 32 local groups across counties but individual group websites are not systematically listed online. Main organization website is primary resource for engagement.

groups.name: MME (Hungarian Ornithological and Nature Conservation Society / BirdLife Hungary)
groups.blurb: The national ornithological society founded in 1974 with 10,000 members and 32 local groups running conservation and research across Hungary.

groups.name: BirdLife Estonia (Estonian Ornithological Society)
groups.blurb: The national ornithological society founded in 1921 with over 600 members, working on bird research, protection and education.

groups.name: Birding Estonia
groups.blurb: Community organization bringing together keen birders in Estonia valuing correct observation recording and bird knowledge sharing.

groups.name: Eagle Club
groups.blurb: A nonprofit organization with 25 members studying and protecting eagles and black storks across Estonia for decades.

name: Latvia
gaps: Latvian Ornithological Society operates across all regions but specific regional branches and local club details are not individually documented online.

groups.name: Latvian Ornithological Society (LOB)
groups.blurb: The largest nature conservation organization in Latvia with 1,000+ members working on bird and habitat protection since 1985.

groups.name: Lithuanian Ornithological Society (LOD / BirdLife Lithuania)
groups.blurb: The national ornithological society and BirdLife partner with 400+ members organizing bird research, protection and public engagement.

groups.name: Lithuanian Bird Ringing Centre
groups.blurb: Scientific facility based at Tadas Ivanauskas Zoological Museum coordinating bird ringing and migration research.
